poc_details: 4-week Dedicated POC: week 0 infra setup + VPC peering; week 1 canary (5% prod traffic) to dedicated pool using model:redwood-medium; week 2 scale to 25% and run synthetic load tests (1k qps bursts) + latency SLO validation; week 3 failure injections: simulate GPU OOM and API regional outage to test fallback routing; week 4 evaluation & roll-back rehearsals. Canary config: gradual routing (5% -> 25%) with automatic health checks and 10-minute rollback window. Fallbacks: route to model:redwood-small-quantized for cost-limited traffic; region failover path to eu-west-1 / us-west-2 depending on origin; circuit-breaker metric = 95th latency >150ms OR error rate >1.5% -> trigger fallback. Rollback playbook documented in drive:/pocs/pacifica-dedicated-playbook.md
technical_requirements: Latency SLO: 95th <= 150ms for short chat responses (<=256 tokens)
